evidence.detail: The class owns one current LoadoutDefinition and renders only that record's visual state through a Graphics surface.
Its renderer loads exact Loadouts assets including loadout_bg.png, normal.png, curses.png, booktag.png, skills.png, outline.png and the pet/cosmetic slot resources.

Rendering consumes the LoadoutDefinition spellbook, prayer state, skill values, 28 backpack LoadoutItemEntry values and the LoadoutEquipmentSlot map, drawing item icons and quantities for both inventory and equipment.
LoadoutManager/LoadoutFolderPanel update this renderer with the active LoadoutDefinition and repaint it as selection changes.

candidates.note: LoadoutPreviewRenderer is fixed by exclusive rendering of the active LoadoutDefinition with exact loadout background, spellbook/prayer/skills, inventory and equipment presentation. Confidence is 0.999.

evidence.detail: The enum preserves 29 exact user-facing icon/category choices including MELEE, RANGE, MAGIC, PURE, WELFARE, SKULL, RED_SKULL, HOTSPOT, SLAYER, BLOOD_SLAYER, RAIDS, EVENT, CASH, BARRAGE, FUN and EMOJI variants.
Each value carries a visible label such as Melee/Range/Magic/Raids and a matching /assets/gui/icons/*.png resource.
LoadoutDefinition stores one rs/gui/b/e value as presentation metadata, and exact Loadouts UI editors/renderers expose and consume that selection.

candidates.note: LoadoutIcon follows exact surviving enum choices/assets and exclusive use as LoadoutDefinition presentation metadata. Confidence is 0.999.

evidence.detail: The class is an immutable two-integer record with constructors (itemId, quantity) and (itemId) where quantity defaults to 1.
LoadoutDefinition stores arrays/maps of these records for backpack and equipment state; LoadoutPersistence serializes/deserializes both integers.
The exact '::item_loadout' spawn path reads the first integer as the item id and the second as quantity when serializing inventory/equipment entries.
LoadoutPreviewRenderer resolves the first integer to an item image and draws the second as the item quantity/count where applicable.

candidates.note: LoadoutItemEntry is a conservative descriptive name for the exact item-id/quantity record used only inside the Loadouts model, persistence, spawn and preview paths. Confidence is 0.999.
